jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Senior iOS (Inglés B2)
jobs_results.description:
En Krell-Consulting estamos buscando un Desarrollador Senior de iOS para unirse a nuestro equipo de profesionales en modalidad remota 100 .

PERFIL Desarrollador Senior Ios

MODALIDAD DE TRABAJO 100 remoto

PROYECTO Soporte para el servicio de desarrollo iOS nativo en el que se aplicaran patrones CLEAN a la hora de resolver problemas y modularización en capas.

Desarrollo y perfeccionamiento de la aplicación iOs nativa se impulsarán iniciativas de funciones desde las ideas y la implementación hasta el lanzamiento. Se revisará el código para garantizar la calidad. Contribución a la mejora continua del producto en un entorno Agile.

FUNCIONES

Desarrollo de iOS añadiendo valor a las Apps del sector bancario.

Revisión del código y mejora de las prácticas comunes.

Pruebas de concepto E2E para agregar valor al producto.

REQUERIDO

Mínimo 3 años de experiencia continuada y especializada en desarrollo iOS nativo (No computan años de experiencia trabajados en tecnologías híbridas como... React Native / Flutter / Xamarin ni trayectorias en las que se indica desarrollo dual iOS/Android dado que no podemos determinar cuánto tiempo de dicha experiencia fue dedicado a iOS y cuál a Android. Similar para el caso de proyectos personales o experiencia como freelance dado que debido a la naturaleza del proyecto es importante que hayan trabajado en equipo).

Haber trabajado en estos proyectos no solo resolver incidencias.

Tecnologías Switf Xcode git UI Conocimiento de UIKit valorable de manera muy positiva SwiftUI.

Haber trabajado con programación con vistas por código.

Testing Test unitarios XCTest Mocks e inyección de dependencias.

Arquitectura conocimientos sobre arquitecturas MVVM VIPER etc saber aplicar patrones CLEAN a la hora de resolver problemas Modularización en capas.

Idiomas Castellano nativo o equivalente. Inglés B2 hablado leído y escrito

Beneficios

Oportunidad de trabajar en un ambiente dinámico y desafiante.

Formar parte de un equipo de alto rendimiento y colaborativo.

Salario competitivo acorde a la experiencia aportada por el candidato.

Contrato indefinido.

Trabajo en remoto 100 .

Si cumples con los requisitos y estás interesado en formar parte de nuestro equipo como Desarrollador Senior de iOS ¡no dudes en postularte!

¡Esperamos contar contigo en Krell-Consulting!

ios,Switf, Xcode

jobs_results.title: iOS Developer - Development (Openbank)
jobs_results.description:
Country: Spain

We are the 100% digital bank of the Santander Group and we are currently undergoing a technological transformation and international expansion. In 2016 the re-launch of the Bank began and since then we have been in continuous expansion and growth, especially in our technological side. We work using agile methodologies to take our clients' experience to the next level. In 2019 we launched the Bank in the Netherlands, Germany and Portugal, with others to follow. Our culture makes us different; social and diversity clubs are part of our essence and allow us to live our culture every day. We are a flexible and fast adapting team that currently works remotely most of the time using all kinds of communication tools, we haven´t noticed the change!

Mission and responsibilities:
• We want to take our customers' digital experience to a new level and you will help us innovate in digital product development in banking.
• Responsibilities:
• You will be responsible for iOS... developments, helping to add value to Openbank Apps, as part of a multidisciplinary team of professionals.
• You will bring your knowledge and experience to the team, proposing ideas for continuous improvement.
• You will participate in code review and contribute to improve common practices.
• You will be responsible for your own proofs of concept to add value to the product.

To be successful in the role you must have
• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other related field. Or equivalent work experience.
• 3+ years of experience in software development.
• Experience in iOS App development.
• Programming skills in Swift 5.
• Strong knowledge of software architecture and clean architectures.
• Advanced knowledge of frameworks for mobile.
• Advanced knowledge of mobile application performance optimization.
• Experience with REST integrations.
• In-depth knowledge of development patterns.
• Experience working with design teams to optimize the final customer experience.
• Knowledge of agile methodology, Scrum and Kanban.
• Ability to learn quickly, creativity and initiative.
• Ability to make autonomous decisions.
• Results oriented.
• Team player.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

What do we offer?
• Immediate incorporation to a dynamic and agile company with a growth and expansion project.
• Working in start-up mode with the support of Grupo Santander.
• Competitive remuneration and attractive benefits package.
• Possibility of growth within the company and the Group.
• Collaboration in international projects and possibility of contact with different countries.
• Excellent work environment, social clubs and frequent events (now virtual).

Would you like to grow with us? Join our team!

Openbank is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered as equal without paying attention to gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, age, political orientation, union membership nor disability status.

We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

If you´re not currently living in Madrid or Valencia and you are open to relocate, we would still love to consider your application.

OBTECH22 OBDEV22 #openbank

Los datos personales que proporciones y los que se generen durante el proceso de selección son confidenciales y serán tratados por Open Bank, S.A./ Open Digital Services, S.L. con domicilio social en Plaza de Santa Bárbara 2, 28004 (Madrid), a los únicos efectos de gestionar tu participación en los procesos de selección y, en su caso, realizar tu contratación.

Tus datos serán conservados el plazo necesario para tramitar los procesos de selección en los que participe. En concreto, salvo que nos indiques lo contrario, tus datos se conservarán por un plazo de 18 meses desde la última postulación transcurrido el cual procederemos a su eliminación.

Puedes ejercer tus derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, portabilidad, limitación al tratamiento y oposición, en cualquier momento, poniéndote en contacto con openprivacy@gruposantander.com

Para más información sobre tus derechos y protección de datos, puedes consultar la política de privacidad de ODS/Openbank, aplicable a este tratamiento, aquí [URL a https://www.openbank.es/assets/static/pdf/politica_privacidad_candidatos_es.pdf]”

The personal data you provide as well as any data generated during the selection process are confidential and will be processed by Open Bank, S.A./ Open Digital Services, S.L. with registered office at Plaza de Santa Bárbara 2, 28004 (Madrid), for the sole purpose of managing your participation in the selection processes and, where appropriate, to formalise your recruitment.

Your data will be kept for the period required to carry out the selection processes that you take part in. Specifically, unless you indicate otherwise, your data will be kept for 18 months following your last application and will be deleted at the end of this period.

You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction of processing and objection at any time by emailing openprivacy@gruposantander.com.

For further information about your rights and data protection, please read the ODS/Openbank Privacy Policy applicable to this type of data processing here. [URL a https://www.openbank.es/assets/static/pdf/politica_privacidad_candidatos_es.pdf

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador iOS - / Remoto
jobs_results.description:
Nuestro cliente, una firma de ingeniería de software especializada en el desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles, está buscando un desarrollador iOS para trabajar 100% en remoto. El objetivo del puesto será la evolución y el desarrollo de funcionalidades para apps en iOS, con la máxima exigencia, calidad y fiabilidad.

Funciones
• Desarrollo para las plataformas iOS, watchOS y tvOS.
• Analizar y formalizar requisitos.
• Participar en las decisiones de diseño.
• Implementación de tests automáticos
Requisitos:
• Licenciatura o grado en Ingeniería informática, telecomunicaciones, física o matemáticas.
• Inglés medio.
• Experiencia mínima de 2 años trabajando en empresa en proyectos de desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles con Swift.

Valorables
• Master Ingeniería informática.
• Sólido conocimiento de los fundamentos de la ingeniería del software en aspectos como las redes TCP/IP, bases de datos y diseño de software.
• iOS: Objetive C, Xcode, Swift.
• Guidelines de Apple.
• TDD.
• Trabajo con... repositorios GIT y herramientas de control de versiones.
• Nivel de Inglés alto.

Que ofrecen
• Contrato indefinido.
• Horario Flexible (35h semanales).
• Trabajo remoto.

jobs_results.title: Senior Mobile Engineer, Android & iOS
jobs_results.description:
We are a leading SaaS company operating in the dynamic cybersecurity space. Our mission is to protect people’s money and sensitive online data through technology. We currently serve millions of end-users and are growing usage at 110% yoy. Our current technology is a state-of-the-art, cloud-based multi-factor authentication and fraud prevention software. We are trusted by tier 1 banks and fintechs, such as Rothschild & Co, Barclays, Santander, Qonto and Scalable Capital.

To learn more about our innovative solutions and team, visit us at

Your mission

You will be responsible for developing, debugging, optimizing and releasing the Futurae mobile SDKs.

You will be part of the mobile SDK product team at Futurae and work closely with our engineers, product managers and the rest of the Futurae product teams to push the limits of our mobile SDK product offering through cutting-edge technologies, stability, quality and security.

You are expected to:
• Develop and maintain the Futurae... mobile SDKs on both platforms (Android & iOS)
• Collaborate with the rest of the product team to deliver innovative product features
• Fully own what you do, make technical decisions, take responsibility and ensure that what you build excels in terms quality, leads to great user experience and adheres to high security standards and engineering best practices

Desirable skills and experience

You are user-focused and thrive in a fast-paced and goal-driven environment. You consider building secure and reliable software to be just the first step in solving user problems.

You are willing to have ownership of what you build and you’d rather ship than over-engineer.

You have a passion for growing yourself and your teammates and always have your sights set on getting better. You want to be a part of building something you can be proud of.
• 5+ years of experience in developing on developing mobile applications and SDKs
• Experience with both Android and iOS and will to work on both platforms is a must
• Strong expertise in Android and Kotlin
• Solid experience and familiarity with iOS and Swift
• Solid understanding of security concepts and secure coding practices
• An obsession for details and desire to know how things work
• Fluent in English
• Enjoy performing in a team environment

Bonus points
• A track record of releasing and maintaining apps or SDKs installed on millions of devices

Why Futurae

Join a young, international, and fast-paced Cybersecurity company with experienced industry leaders
• Futurae Stock Options
• Yearly personal learning & development budget
• Apple Laptop and equipment for work purposes
• Ability to work remotely (European time zones only)
• Work at the forefront of an inspiring, dynamic tech company in the B2B space in the area of end-user authentication and transaction confirmation
• Be part of our friendly, knowledge-sharing, entrepreneurial culture and flat hierarchy, where we value open and respectful communication, collaboration and an attitude that gets things done for our customers
• Work in a role that gives you responsibility and independence
• Access to coaching, ongoing professional development and training, mentorship and our culture of continuous learning.

Futurae is an Equal Opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

By sending your application, you allow Futurae to handle and store your data.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: IOS Mobile Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are a digitally native company that helps organizations reinvent themselves and unleash their potential. Our innovative approach combines design, engineering, and scale to create cutting-edge solutions for our clients.

Right now, we are looking for an IOS Developer to join our team!

You will get the chance to:
• Helps to review existing processes and propose changes (when needed).
• Work with professionals who have created some of the most revolutionary solutions in their fields..
• Make an impact. Work in large-scale projects globally.
• Develop your career in our Studios. Each Studio represents deep pockets of expertise on the latest technologies and trends and delivers tailored solutions focused on specific challenges.
• Be empowered to choose your career path: we have more than 600 simultaneous projects, so you can choose where and how to work.

What will help you succeed:
• Advanced or intermediate English skills.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in IOS Development.
• Live in... Spain
• BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience/skills.
• Experience working with native iOS development (Cocoa Touch).
• Good understanding of iOS architecture, patterns and open-sourcers libraries.
• Solid iOS and Swift theoretical and practical knowledge.
• Develops across the entire app life cycle –concept, design, build, deploy, test, release to App Store of PlayStore and support.
• Proficient in Scrum/Agile methodologies.
• Desirable Objective-C experience.
• Excellent communication skills.

If you want to know more about our benefits and perks click here.

Job Segment: Developer, Testing, Computer Science, Design Engineer, Programmer, Technology, Engineering

jobs_results.description:
¡Bienvenido/a a la Comunidad Mobile de knowmad mood! ☕️

En knowmad mood ofrecemos soluciones completas de movilidad. Nos esforzamos en dar un servicio global desde la consultoría donde se evalúa la situación actual y se proponen planes de mejora, hasta soluciones avanzadas como la realidad aumentada, servicios de geolocalización o seguridad, sin olvidarnos de todas las fases por las que pasa una aplicación desde que es una idea hasta que se materializa con la subida a los stores.

Si no buscas solo un lugar para trabajar, sino un sitio donde seguir creciendo como profesional y como persona, pero en el que, además la formación continua también sea protagonista: ¡este es tu sitio!.

Actualmente nos encontramos en búsqueda de Desarrolladores mobile con experiencia en Flutter y en iOS, que estén listos para un nuevo desafío.

Se precisa nivel alto de ingles.

Proyectos 100% remoto!!

Te identificas con esta descripción?, no esperes más y ¡¡únete a nosotros!!

¡Únete a nuestro equipo... únete a knowmad mood! y disfruta de:

- Plan de carrera 🏄 Tu crecimiento es el nuestro, por eso, todos nuestros profesionales tienen a su disposición procesos diseñados específicamente para sus funciones dentro de la compañía: modelo de competencias, evaluaciones, planes de formación y certificación, proyectos y eventos.

- Retribución Flexible 💰Podrás optar por cheques restaurante, cheques guardería, tarjeta de transporte, o seguro médico. Junto los beneficios y descuentos que te proponemos al unirte al Club de ventajas AT.

- Conciliación vida familiar y laboral 💆Nos gusta que tengas equilibrio en tu vida personal y en tu carrera profesional, por lo que disfrutamos de 22 días de vacaciones + 2 días de libre disposición + 24 y 31 de diciembre (cierre de empresa), además de opciones de teletrabajo, horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes y en verano.

- Formación continua 💻 como medio para conseguir el desarrollo personal y profesional de nuestros compañeros. Tendrás opciones para formarte en últimas tecnologías, inglés, competencias/habilidades. Además de nuestro programa de certificaciones oficiales.

- Wellness 🔋Promovemos un estilo de vida saludable entre todos los que formamos knowmad mood y, por eso, contamos con varias iniciativas que fomentan nuestra salud y bienestar. Nuestro equipo de People Care está siempre a ti disposición para que las experiencias en knowmad mood sean humanas y lo más alegres posible.

jobs_results.title: Desarrolladores Mobile (IOS & Android)
jobs_results.description:
¿De qué va la empresa en la que trabajarás?

Somos una empresa de soluciones móviles corporativas, la cual desde hace 10 años viene centrado su misión en acelerar la digitalización tecnológica de la sociedad, desarrollamos tanto webs como apps híbridas.

En estos años nuestro equipo ha dado forma a más de 1000 proyectos para 150 clientes con presencia nacional e internacional.

¿En qué creemos?

Nos basamos en cuatro valores fundamentales:
• Innovación, ofreciendo soluciones innovadoras de una manera profesional y rentable con un valor diferencial: el conocimiento experto en toda la cadena de valor.
• Compromiso ya que llevamos como propios los objetivos de la organización y superamos cualquier obstáculo para lograrlos.
• Proactividad, proveyendo y realizando acciones para mejorar sus servicios y calidad.
• Trabajo en equipo, contando con un equipo motivado y multidisciplinar que trabaja en perfecta coordinación para lograr los objetivos comunes.

Requisitos:

Buscamos gente como tú... para trabajar en distintos proyectos Mobile en distintas ubicaciones y/o en remoto.

Nos gustaría que fueras un compañero con:
• Perfil con 2 - 3 años de experiencia
• Experiencia en alguna/as de estas herramientas o entornos IOS, Android, React, Angular, GIT, Swift / SwiftU, API´s RESTful, Objective-C ......
• Experiencia trabajando con metodología agile
• Inglés será un plus

¿Cómo será tu día a día en Slash?
• Participarás en proyectos para diferentes clientes y con diferente alcance. ¡Apostamos a qué no te aburrirás!
• Trabajarás con metodologías ágiles.
• Estarás en un equipo que valora las ideas y propuestas de los otros. En búsqueda de constante mejora.
• Diseñarás vistas con auto layouts.
• Realizarás estimaciones de proyectos, auditorías de aplicaciones y gestionarás bugs y errores.
• Colaborarás con diferentes compañeros en función del proyecto, conocerás (si es nueva para ti) la metodología squads.
• Tendrás a disposición diferentes opciones para formarte y seguir creciendo como profesional.

¡Formarás parte de un equipo al que le gusta trabajar bien pero pasarlo mejor!

El SlashTeam te está esperando

jobs_results.title: Junior iOS Developer (relocation to Frankfurt)
jobs_results.company_name: Zero to One Search | Recruitment Agency
jobs_results.description:
Our client operates a digital insurance platform specializing in comparison services and streamlined insurance product purchases online. Their platform enables users to easily compare a wide range of insurance policies, spanning car, health, home, and travel insurance, sourced from diverse providers, ensuring they secure the best-suited coverage for their requirements.

Committed to fostering talent with a fervor for native app development, the company provides a nurturing atmosphere conducive to professional advancement. They prioritize ongoing learning, communal knowledge exchange, and a culture of collaboration within their team. Presently, they are in search of a Junior iOS Developer to join their InsurTech division based in Frankfurt.

Location: Frankfurt, Germany.

Type of contract: Permanent, on-site.

Your Tasks:
• Contribute to shaping the overarching app architecture and collaborate on essential cross-sectional functionalities.
• Innovatively design and implement new... features tailored for the iOS app.
• Foster close collaboration with fellow team members and product management.
• Engage proactively in the design and development lifecycle of the app.

Requirements
• Completion of a degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent training as an IT specialist specializing in application development.
• Demonstrated initial professional exposure, such as internships or roles as a working student, with familiarity in Xcode, Swift, and SwiftUI.
• A collaborative team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving, thriving in a professional development environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.

Benefits
• Experience the best of both worlds: blending perks from an established online company with startup energy. Employees have the chance to shape processes while enjoying long-term planning.
• Developer Experience: Join a vibrant app community rooted in the Frankfurt tech scene, with regular meet-ups and code reviews.
• Salary: Enjoy an attractive package including vouchers, a Sodexo card, subsidized pension plan, and inflation compensation.
• Work-life balance: Flexible options for mobile working/home office (3 days in-office, 2 days flexible).
• "Work From Anywhere": Up to 4 weeks of remote work abroad per year.
• Supportive Equipment: Start with ergonomic workspaces equipped with modern tools like MacBook and height-adjustable tables.
• Team Spirit: Enjoy a relaxed environment, informal culture, and regular team events with amenities like table tennis and rooftop terrace.
• Personal Growth: Access a broad training catalogue and personalized career development support.
• Food & Drinks: Complimentary hot and cold beverages, cereals, lunches, and fresh fruit provided.
• Sustainable Mobility: Convenient travel options via public transport or bicycle with incentives like a free Germany ticket and company bicycle leasing

jobs_results.title: Mid iOS Developer
jobs_results.description:
One of the companies we work with is looking for a Mid iOS Developer to join the team.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for a talented and passionate Mid iOS Developer to join our mobile development team. You’ll be leading our efforts to build amazing UI/UX on our apps, including the most popular Motivation app - with over 20 million users.

Our offer:
• 🧠 Work on products that matter: 2 of our apps are among the most downloaded apps in the Mental Health space, with a 4.9 rating and over 500k reviews each.
• 📈 We’re bootstrapped and profitable, and we believe we can continue growing sustainably without pressure from outside investors or an exit strategy.
• ⌛We are a remote team and strive for an ideal work-life balance: work asynchronously as much as possible and minimize meetings to set your schedule with flexible hours.
• 🐒 Enjoy extra holidays → 4 additional company-wide days off (one per quarter).
• 🏖️ Extended vacations after your 1st year -up to 5 additional days... plus the possibility to travel and work from anywhere.
• 💻 Choose your ideal remote work setup with an equipment allowance.
• 💳 Manage your compensation options (via Cobee) → food and daycare expenses, medical insurance.
• 😌 Mental healthcare support.
• 🍸 Enjoy outings, paid for by the company.
• 🪪 Manage licenses for Work-Related Software → budget to have the necessary software to excel in your role.
• 🏛️ Boost your English skills → free lessons with a native speaker.
• Salary range starting at 50.000€.

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate closely with Designers, Product Managers, and Backend Developers to ensure seamless integration of UI components and functionality.
• Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve our core apps.
• Write high quality, high-performing and well-tested code.
• Turn design requirements and prototypes into working features.
• Work and play with many different libraries and tools (Widgets, WatchOS, Notification Center, etc).

Requirements:
• Positive attitude, a real passion for apps, genuine care of our users, and strong ownership of the product.
• At least 4+ years of writing Swift code.
• Experience working with SwiftUI.
• Passion for creating delightful user interfaces, with attention to detail.
• Design and develop innovative, user-friendly, and visually stunning iOS applications creating delightful User Interfaces.
• Employ creative problem-solving skills to overcome UI challenges and provide elegant solutions that enhance the UX.
• Expertise in building visually appealing UIs, ability to share your experience with other members of the development team.
• Strong problem-solving skills and experience in troubleshooting bugs and performance issues in iOS applications.
• Ability to work well with others by listening, giving constructive feedback and communicating clearly.
• Ability to hack solutions when necessary, making the right trade-offs in dealing with conflicting priorities.
• Passion for mental health, positive psychology and self-improvement.

Nice to haves:
• Experience managing growth initiatives like A/B testing and rapid prototyping.
• Strong grasp of iOS Apple development tools (e.g. Organizer, LLDB, and Instruments) and different SDKs.
• Experience working in a high-growth startup.

Joppy is a tech recruitment platform built for developers by developers.

✅ No CV required. Just say what you know and what you want.

✅ Anonymous profile by default.

✅ You choose who can talk to you. Companies can't write to you until you accept their offer.

✅ Only relevant offers matching your preferences. No more Javascript offers for Java developers.

✅ Get a reward if you get hired.

Keep an eye on tech job opportunities anonymously and match the job that makes you happy
